value.title: ExTensor: An Accelerator for Sparse Tensor Algebra
value.edition: MICRO-52 2019 proceedings, pp319-333, DOI10.1145/3352460.3358275; cached primary15pages
value.locator_basis: 1-based cached PDF pages; proceedings page numbers319-333

value.statement: Scanners emit increasing coordinates and EOS; Intersect consumes matching heads together, drops the smaller head, and flushes when either stream ends.
limitations: Paper-level contract; no authenticated RTL, DMA/register ABI, physical ownership or measured reproduction.

value.statement: Bidirectional SkipTo hints originate only from successfully output coordinates. A subsequent hint cannot be consumed before the previous hint frontier is reached. A coarse CAM tracks coordinates and metadata addresses; its registers are double buffered with a second metadata read port.
limitations: Paper-level contract; no authenticated RTL, DMA/register ABI, physical ownership or measured reproduction.

value.statement: Sequencer configuration supplies loop bounds, strides and tensor-dimension maps. Iterate selects a level and parent. Coordinate-position tuples surviving intersection address separate operand data storage; tile coordinates accompany delivered data.
limitations: Paper-level contract; no authenticated RTL, DMA/register ABI, physical ownership or measured reproduction.

value.statement: DRAM-level scanners sequence tiles; LLB intersects PE metadata with post-intersection fills; PEs intersect datapath metadata with pre-intersection scalar fills. Input tensors are tiled compressed sparse fibers in the evaluated design, and oversized PE tiles may be split across PEs.
limitations: Paper-level contract; no authenticated RTL, DMA/register ABI, physical ownership or measured reproduction.

value.statement: PE partial outputs carry coordinates to a hash-table partial output buffer; COO output tiles are converted on fill and unloaded by sequential hash iteration. Reduction reorderability is assumed for the tensor algebra; it does not establish source-order IEEE bit equality.
limitations: Paper-level contract; no authenticated RTL, DMA/register ABI, physical ownership or measured reproduction.

value.statement: Configuration specifies tensor tiling, loop nest/dataflow and connectivity; low-level DMA, buffer partition, control FSM and routes are omitted. Evaluated tensors use double precision, with 128 PEs, 64 KB PEB per PE and CAM T=32. TACO configuration generation is future work.
limitations: Paper-level contract; no authenticated RTL, DMA/register ABI, physical ownership or measured reproduction.

value.description: Configured tensor-fiber coordinate intersections with position-tagged operand delivery across a memory hierarchy; no inherited general gather capability.

value.name: ExTensor MICRO2019 ordered fiber operand delivery
value.summary: Explicit compressed tensor mapping that intersects sorted coordinates before delivering position-addressed operands; scalar arithmetic is outside this operation.

interface.software_supplies: Tiled tensor metadata/data, canonical fibers, parent/tile coordinates, loop bounds/strides/dimension maps and buffer/routes configuration.
interface.invocation: Configure sequencers and Scanner Iterate(level,parent); optional synchronized SkipTo. Low-level register/DMA ABI is not supplied.
interface.outputs: Matched coordinate with separate A/B positions and tagged scalar or subtile operand data.

realization.description: Select canonical tensor fibers, merge increasing coordinates, retain both positions and parent/tile identities, fetch matched operand values, terminate at EOS and drain outstanding delivery.

result.form: Coordinate-tagged operand pair; not a generic CPU gather return or scalar reduction result.
result.validity: Only explicitly configured canonical fiber/tensor mapping with authenticated positions, owners and finite bounds.

ordering.scope: Within one declared pair of increasing coordinate fibers
ordering.description: Matching coordinates are emitted in increasing order. No global FIFO, request/response ABI or source-ordered partial-sum semantics follows.

completion.event: Intersect observes stream EOS and flushes unmatched remainder; concrete integration must additionally drain all issued operand reads.
completion.visibility: Host-visible kernel/writeback completion and physical coherence are unproved by stream EOS.

type_constraints.notes: Double-precision evaluation supports this scoped payload; coordinate/index bit width and concrete transport encoding remain unknown.

operations.datatype_notes: Opaque float64 operand bits only; no product, accumulation, rounding, FMA or IEEE order claim.
limitations: No generic gather, BFS traversal, scatter atomic or returned old value capability.
Canonical unique fibers are an explicit conservative restriction; duplicate-coordinate ABI unknown.

requirements.description: Explicitly map sorted unique compressed fibers, per-level parent and tile identity, coordinate-to-position storage bounds. Duplicate handling is not specified; this proposal requires canonical unique coordinates.
Prove tensor format, level/dimension maps, loop nesting/strides, tile partition and per-owner data positions; no arbitrary program-address stream substitution.
If optimized SkipTo is enabled, only successfully output coordinates may create hints; preserve previous hint frontier and double-buffer lifetimes.
Declare finite metadata/data/output capacities; no matching operand pair may be consumed without output storage. Handle overfull PE tiles by a proved partition.
Stream EOS is not kernel memory visibility: prove all outstanding value reads, partial-output merges, writebacks and software completion separately.
Scalar arithmetic and partial sums need independent original numerical legality. No ordered floating-point reduction equivalence is granted.
Authenticate model/RTL, DMA and physical-memory ownership, instruction/command interface and completion mechanism before integration.

internal_mechanisms.description: Metadata scanner storage and separate data storage preserve coordinate-position associations; comparator registers are double buffered.
Basic smaller-head drop/matching-head issue, optionally synchronized bidirectional SkipTo hints; sequencer skips empty parents.
Level/parent/tile coordinates and positions accompany survivors; previous SkipTo frontier constrains new hints.
LLB post-intersection tile fills and PE pre-intersection scalar fills filter work at distinct granularities.
POB hashes output coordinates and locally accumulates partial results, allocating entries on first use.
Paper assumes associative tensor reduction permits partial outputs to be reordered; actual IEEE numerical legality remains required.
EOS ends intersection and flushes unmatched streams. Kernel software fence/DMA completion ABI is not specified.

limitations: Logical paper mapping, not RTL/port netlist or measured implementation.
Physical translation, protection, cache coherence, exception and callback credit ABI unknown.
No inheritance of arbitrary indexed-load or graph traversal capabilities.
Abstract finite merge helper does not implement optimized CAM SkipTo or hierarchy timing.
